instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security

questions.question: What does a VPN create across an untrusted network?
questions.question_ar: شنو ينشئ الـ VPN عبر شبكة غير موثوقة؟
options: An encrypted tunnel between the endpoints.
A compressed tunnel between the endpoints.
A routed path that avoids all middleboxes.
A cached session shared by all users.
options_ar: مساراً موجّهاً يتجنّب كل الأجهزة الوسيطة.
جلسة مخزّنة يشترك بها كل المستخدمين.
options_en: An encrypted tunnel between the endpoints.
A compressed tunnel between the endpoints.
A routed path that avoids all middleboxes.
A cached session shared by all users.
questions.explanation: It secures communications across untrusted networks by creating encrypted tunnels, so the public internet behaves like an extension of the private network.
questions.explanation_ar: يؤمّن الاتصالات عبر الشبكات غير الموثوقة بإنشاء أنفاق مشفّرة، فالإنترنت العام يتصرّف كامتداد للشبكة الخاصة.

questions.question: Which three properties does a VPN provide?
questions.question_ar: أي ثلاث خصائص يوفّرها الـ VPN؟
options: Authentication, compression and caching.
Confidentiality, integrity and endpoint authentication.
Confidentiality, availability and load balancing.
Integrity, anonymity and non-repudiation.
options_en: Authentication, compression and caching.
Confidentiality, integrity and endpoint authentication.
Confidentiality, availability and load balancing.
Integrity, anonymity and non-repudiation.
questions.explanation: Those three are what let a private network be extended over the public internet without trusting the path.
questions.explanation_ar: هذي الثلاثة هي اللي تخلي الشبكة الخاصة تمتد فوق الإنترنت العام بلا ثقة بالمسار.

questions.question: At which layer does IPsec operate?
questions.question_ar: بأي طبقة يعمل IPsec؟
options: At the application layer, per RFC 8484.
At the link layer, per RFC 6105.
At the IP layer, per RFC 4301.
At the transport layer, per RFC 8446.
options_en: At the application layer, per RFC 8484.
At the link layer, per RFC 6105.
At the IP layer, per RFC 4301.
At the transport layer, per RFC 8446.
questions.explanation: IPsec is an IP-layer family, which is why it can protect any protocol carried above it without changing the applications.
questions.explanation_ar: IPsec عائلة بطبقة IP، ولهذا يقدر يحمي أي بروتوكول فوقه بلا ما تتغيّر التطبيقات.

questions.question: Which two modes does IPsec support?
questions.question_ar: أي نمطين يدعمهما IPsec؟
options: Bridge mode and routed mode.
Forward mode and reverse mode.
Stateful mode and stateless mode.
Tunnel mode and transport mode.
options_en: Bridge mode and routed mode.
Forward mode and reverse mode.
Stateful mode and stateless mode.
Tunnel mode and transport mode.
questions.explanation: Tunnel mode wraps the whole original packet, while transport mode protects the payload and leaves the original IP header in place.
questions.explanation_ar: نمط النفق يلفّ الحزمة الأصلية كاملة، ونمط النقل يحمي الحمولة ويترك ترويسة IP الأصلية بمكانها.

questions.question: What is the division of labour between ESP and AH in IPsec?
questions.question_ar: كيف يتقاسم ESP و AH العمل داخل IPsec؟
options: ESP gives confidentiality, AH gives authentication.
ESP gives authentication, AH gives confidentiality.
Both give confidentiality and neither authenticates.
Both authenticate but neither encrypts payloads.
options_ar: ESP يعطي السرية، و AH يعطي المصادقة.
ESP يعطي المصادقة، و AH يعطي السرية.
options_en: ESP gives confidentiality, AH gives authentication.
ESP gives authentication, AH gives confidentiality.
Both give confidentiality and neither authenticates.
Both authenticate but neither encrypts payloads.
questions.explanation: Encapsulating Security Payload carries the encryption, while Authentication Header carries integrity and authentication of the packet.
questions.explanation_ar: ESP يحمل التشفير، و AH يحمل سلامة الحزمة ومصادقتها.

questions.question: At which layers do SSL and TLS VPNs operate?
questions.question_ar: بأي طبقات تعمل شبكات SSL و TLS الخاصة؟
options: At the physical and data-link layers.
At the transport and application layers.
At the network and link layers.
At the session and presentation layers only.
options_en: At the physical and data-link layers.
At the transport and application layers.
At the network and link layers.
At the session and presentation layers only.
questions.explanation: They leverage TLS, so they sit higher in the stack than IPsec and are typically delivered through a browser or a client application.
questions.explanation_ar: تستفيد من TLS، فتجلس أعلى بالمكدّس من IPsec وتُقدَّم عادة عبر متصفح أو تطبيق عميل.

questions.question: Which modern primitives does WireGuard rely on?
questions.question_ar: على أي مكوّنات حديثة يعتمد WireGuard؟
options: Finite-field Diffie-Hellman and triple DES.
ECDSA signatures and the RC4 stream cipher.
Curve25519 and ChaCha20-Poly1305.
RSA-2048 for key exchange and AES-256-CBC.
options_en: Finite-field Diffie-Hellman and triple DES.
ECDSA signatures and the RC4 stream cipher.
Curve25519 and ChaCha20-Poly1305.
RSA-2048 for key exchange and AES-256-CBC.
questions.explanation: WireGuard deliberately uses a small modern set rather than offering a menu of legacy options, which is what keeps its codebase tiny.
questions.explanation_ar: WireGuard يستخدم عمداً مجموعة حديثة صغيرة بدل ما يعرض قائمة خيارات قديمة، وهذا اللي يخلي قاعدة شيفرته ضئيلة.

questions.question: What does WireGuard emphasise in its design?
questions.question_ar: على شنو يشدّد WireGuard بتصميمه؟
options: Feature completeness and legacy compatibility.
Hardware acceleration and vendor certification.
Centralised management and deep inspection.
Simplicity and a minimal codebase.
options_en: Feature completeness and legacy compatibility.
Hardware acceleration and vendor certification.
Centralised management and deep inspection.
Simplicity and a minimal codebase.
questions.explanation: A smaller surface is easier to audit, and WireGuard trades configurability for that auditability.
questions.explanation_ar: سطح أصغر أسهل بالتدقيق، و WireGuard يقايض القابلية للتخصيص مقابل تلك القابلية للتدقيق.

questions.question: Which deployment model fits a teleworker connecting from home?
questions.question_ar: أي نموذج نشر يلائم عاملاً عن بُعد يتصل من بيته؟
options: A remote access VPN.
A site-to-site VPN.
A cloud-native VPN.
A reverse proxy deployment.
options_en: A remote access VPN.
A site-to-site VPN.
A cloud-native VPN.
A reverse proxy deployment.
questions.explanation: Remote access VPNs exist to secure teleworker connections back into the corporate network.
questions.explanation_ar: شبكات الوصول عن بُعد موجودة لتأمين اتصالات العاملين عن بُعد رجوعاً لشبكة الشركة.

questions.question: What do site-to-site VPNs connect?
questions.question_ar: شنو تربط شبكات الموقعين؟
options: Certificate authorities to the root store.
Geographically dispersed enterprise sites.
Individual teleworkers to the head office.
Public cloud tenants to each other's data.
options_en: Certificate authorities to the root store.
Geographically dispersed enterprise sites.
Individual teleworkers to the head office.
Public cloud tenants to each other's data.
questions.explanation: Site-to-site VPNs join dispersed enterprise locations into one logical network over the public internet.
questions.explanation_ar: شبكات الموقعين تربط مواقع المؤسسة المتباعدة بشبكة منطقية واحدة فوق الإنترنت العام.

questions.question: What do cloud-native VPNs integrate with?
questions.question_ar: مع شنو تتكامل الشبكات السحابية المنشأ؟
options: Industrial control and SCADA networks.
Satellite links and radio backhauls.
Multi-cloud and hybrid environments.
Legacy mainframe and terminal systems.
options_en: Industrial control and SCADA networks.
Satellite links and radio backhauls.
Multi-cloud and hybrid environments.
Legacy mainframe and terminal systems.
questions.explanation: Cloud-native VPNs are built for the multi-cloud and hybrid topologies that enterprise estates now actually have.
questions.explanation_ar: الشبكات السحابية المنشأ مبنية للطوبولوجيات متعدّدة السحابات والهجينة اللي صارت موجودة فعلاً ببيئات المؤسسات.

questions.question: Which weaknesses does the chapter attribute to VPN deployments?
questions.question_ar: أي نقاط ضعف ينسبها الفصل لنشر الشبكات الخاصة؟
options: Packet fragmentation, header rewriting and MTU issues.
Cache poisoning, zone transfer and resolver hijack.
Clock drift, log ordering and ticket lifetime.
Misconfiguration, weak authentication and credential theft.
options_ar: تجزئة الحزم وإعادة كتابة الترويسات ومشاكل MTU.
تسميم الكاش ونقل المنطقة واختطاف المحلّل.
انحراف الساعة وترتيب السجلات وعمر التذاكر.
أخطاء الإعداد والمصادقة الضعيفة وسرقة بيانات الاعتماد.
options_en: Packet fragmentation, header rewriting and MTU issues.
Cache poisoning, zone transfer and resolver hijack.
Clock drift, log ordering and ticket lifetime.
Misconfiguration, weak authentication and credential theft.
questions.explanation: Misconfiguration, weak authentication, obsolete protocols and stolen credentials are what actually undermine VPNs in practice.
questions.explanation_ar: أخطاء الإعداد والمصادقة الضعيفة والبروتوكولات المتقادمة وسرقة بيانات الاعتماد هي اللي تقوّض الـ VPN عملياً.

questions.question: Which protocols does the chapter name as obsolete for VPN use?
questions.question_ar: أي بروتوكولات يسمّيها الفصل متقادمة لاستخدام VPN؟
options: PPTP and L2TP without IPsec.
WireGuard and modern TLS-based VPNs.
IPsec in tunnel mode and IKEv2.
DNS-over-TLS and DNS-over-HTTPS.
options_ar: WireGuard والشبكات المبنية على TLS الحديث.
options_en: PPTP and L2TP without IPsec.
WireGuard and modern TLS-based VPNs.
IPsec in tunnel mode and IKEv2.
DNS-over-TLS and DNS-over-HTTPS.
questions.explanation: PPTP and L2TP without IPsec lack adequate cryptographic protection, so they are listed as legacy rather than recommended.
questions.explanation_ar: PPTP و L2TP بدون IPsec يفتقدان حماية تشفيرية كافية، فلهذا يُذكران كإرث قديم مو كتوصية.

questions.question: Why is compromising a VPN gateway especially severe?
questions.question_ar: ليش اختراق بوابة VPN خطير بشكل خاص؟
options: It forces every user onto a weaker cipher suite.
It gives the attacker broad lateral movement inside.
It exposes the encryption keys of every client.
It disables all certificates on the internal hosts.
options_ar: يجبر كل مستخدم على مجموعة تشفير أضعف.
يعطي المهاجم حركة جانبية واسعة بالداخل.
يعطّل كل الشهادات على الأجهزة الداخلية.
options_en: It forces every user onto a weaker cipher suite.
It gives the attacker broad lateral movement inside.
It exposes the encryption keys of every client.
It disables all certificates on the internal hosts.
questions.explanation: The gateway is the single point where the outside is trusted inside, so whoever holds it inherits that trust for the whole internal network.
questions.explanation_ar: البوابة هي النقطة الوحيدة اللي يُوثق فيها بالخارج داخل الشبكة، فاللي يمسكها يرث تلك الثقة على كل الشبكة الداخلية.

questions.question: Does deploying a VPN remove the risk of an untrusted network?
questions.question_ar: هل نشر VPN يزيل خطر الشبكة غير الموثوقة؟
options: Yes, because the traffic becomes unreadable to all.
No, because the tunnel weakens the encryption used.
No, it shifts the trust to the endpoints and gateway.
Yes, because the tunnel cannot be intercepted.
options_ar: نعم، لأن الترافيك يصير غير مقروء للجميع.
لا، لأن النفق يضعّف التشفير المستخدم.
لا، بل ينقل الثقة إلى الأطراف والبوابة.
نعم، لأن النفق ما يمكن اعتراضه.
options_en: Yes, because the traffic becomes unreadable to all.
No, because the tunnel weakens the encryption used.
No, it shifts the trust to the endpoints and gateway.
Yes, because the tunnel cannot be intercepted.
questions.explanation: The tunnel protects the path, but the endpoints and the gateway become the new concentration of trust, and that is where attacks then go.
questions.explanation_ar: النفق يحمي المسار، بس الأطراف والبوابة تصير التجمّع الجديد للثقة، وهناك تنتقل الهجمات بعدها.

questions.question: How is the residual interception probability expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعبَّر عن احتمال الاعتراض المتبقّي؟
options: One plus VPN efficacy, times the prior probability.
VPN efficacy divided by the prior probability.
Prior probability divided by the VPN efficacy.
One minus VPN efficacy, times the prior probability.
options_ar: واحد زائد فاعلية الـ VPN، مضروباً بالاحتمال السابق.
فاعلية الـ VPN مقسومة على الاحتمال السابق.
الاحتمال السابق مقسوماً على فاعلية الـ VPN.
واحد ناقص فاعلية الـ VPN، مضروباً بالاحتمال السابق.
options_en: One plus VPN efficacy, times the prior probability.
VPN efficacy divided by the prior probability.
Prior probability divided by the VPN efficacy.
One minus VPN efficacy, times the prior probability.
questions.explanation: It follows the same efficacy pattern used throughout the chapter: the encryption removes a fraction of the interception probability.
questions.explanation_ar: يتبع نفس نمط الفاعلية المستخدم بكل الفصل: التشفير يزيل كسراً من احتمال الاعتراض.

questions.question: What happens to the residual interception probability at the two extremes of VPN efficacy?
questions.question_ar: شنو يصير لاحتمال الاعتراض المتبقّي عند طرفي فاعلية الـ VPN؟
options: It equals the prior at zero efficacy and nears zero at full.
It doubles at zero efficacy and halves at full efficacy.
It stays fixed regardless of the efficacy value.
It rises as efficacy rises, because of the overhead.
options_ar: يساوي الاحتمال السابق عند فاعلية صفر ويقترب من الصفر عند الفاعلية الكاملة.
يتضاعف عند فاعلية صفر وينصف عند الفاعلية الكاملة.
يبقى ثابتاً بغض النظر عن قيمة الفاعلية.
يرتفع كل ما ارتفعت الفاعلية، بسبب الكلفة.
options_en: It equals the prior at zero efficacy and nears zero at full.
It doubles at zero efficacy and halves at full efficacy.
It stays fixed regardless of the efficacy value.
It rises as efficacy rises, because of the overhead.
questions.explanation: With no efficacy the tunnel changes nothing, and with perfect efficacy the interception probability is driven to zero.
questions.explanation_ar: بلا فاعلية النفق ما يغيّر شي، وبفاعلية كاملة يُدفع احتمال الاعتراض إلى الصفر.

questions.question: How is the transmission time with a VPN expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعبَّر عن زمن الإرسال مع الـ VPN؟
options: Baseline time divided by the encryption overhead.
Baseline time plus the encryption overhead.
Baseline time minus the encryption overhead.
Baseline time multiplied by the encryption overhead.
options_ar: الزمن الأساسي مقسوماً على كلفة التشفير.
options_en: Baseline time divided by the encryption overhead.
Baseline time plus the encryption overhead.
Baseline time minus the encryption overhead.
Baseline time multiplied by the encryption overhead.
questions.explanation: The tunnel adds work to every packet, so the latency is the baseline plus that added cost rather than a fraction of it.
questions.explanation_ar: النفق يضيف شغلاً لكل حزمة، فالزمن هو الأساسي زائد تلك الكلفة، مو كسراً منه.

questions.question: What is the practical goal when choosing VPN strength?
questions.question_ar: شنو الهدف العملي عند اختيار قوة الـ VPN؟
options: Minimise latency and accept any encryption.
Match the cipher to the vendor's default.
Optimise efficacy against an acceptable latency.
Maximise efficacy regardless of the latency.
options_ar: تحسين الفاعلية مقابل زمن استجابة مقبول.
تعظيم الفاعلية بغض النظر عن الزمن.
options_en: Minimise latency and accept any encryption.
Match the cipher to the vendor's default.
Optimise efficacy against an acceptable latency.
Maximise efficacy regardless of the latency.
questions.explanation: The trade-off is explicit: stronger encryption buys security and costs latency, so the right answer is the balance the use case can tolerate.
questions.explanation_ar: المقايضة صريحة: تشفير أقوى يشتري أماناً ويكلّف زمن استجابة، فالجواب الصح هو التوازن اللي يتحمّله الاستخدام.

questions.question: Why is a VPN not an authorization mechanism?
questions.question_ar: ليش الـ VPN مو آلية تخويل؟
options: It encrypts the traffic but never authenticates endpoints.
It authorizes users but does not encrypt their traffic.
It replaces directory services for user identity.
It transports traffic securely but does not decide permissions.
options_ar: يشفّر الترافيك بس ما يصادق الأطراف أبداً.
يخوّل المستخدمين بس ما يشفّر ترافيكهم.
ينقل الترافيك بأمان بس ما يقرّر الصلاحيات.
options_en: It encrypts the traffic but never authenticates endpoints.
It authorizes users but does not encrypt their traffic.
It replaces directory services for user identity.
It transports traffic securely but does not decide permissions.
questions.explanation: A VPN provides encrypted transport and endpoint authentication; what a user is then allowed to do is a separate authorization decision.
questions.explanation_ar: الـ VPN يوفّر نقلاً مشفّراً ومصادقة أطراف؛ أما شنو مسموح للمستخدم يسوي فهذا قرار تخويل منفصل.
